title: Airtable API calls are blocked or slowed to 2 per second partway through the month
symptoms: Every request returns 429 until the workspace is upgraded or the monthly counter resets (Free plan, after the grace period)
Team plan integration slows to about 2 requests per second until the 1st of the month
Usage looks fine per second but the integration still gets throttled
cause: On top of per-second limits, each workspace has a monthly call allowance: 1,000 on Free and 100,000 on Team. Free workspaces are blocked after a one-time grace period, and Team workspaces are throttled to 2 requests per second until the month resets.
fix: Count calls per month, cache reads, batch writes to 10 records per call, and move heavy integrations to a plan with a higher allowance.
apply: Workspace settings (owner access) > Summary > Public API calls for the current month; per base: Usage tab > Bases > Public API Usage
affected: Airtable Free and Team plans, monthly API call limits as published 2026-10
